claims.assertion: Swaruu X says the Van Allen belts set Earth’s baseline 3D frequency, but people can transcend it through greater awareness.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her numerical frequency scale is illustrative.

claims.assertion: She says the brain translates astral experiences into physical memories; recall depends on processing and frequency compatibility, while life-plan and familial patterns are encoded in DNA.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says transcending the belts alone does not guarantee recall.
